messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — chat continuity gaps (timeouts → partial responses) + recurring pattern notes. I sketched owners/timelines, please ack or reassign by EOD. TL;DR: three deliverables: heartbeat/alerting, client handshake hardening, retry-window tuning + improved logs.

kevin: I can take heartbeat/alerting. Plan: spike this week to validate metrics, PR for prometheus exporter + alert rules by next Tue.

ahmed: I’ll own retry-window and backoff defaults for the server runtime. Will run load sims and propose new defaults (and a feature flag) — aiming for RFC + tests in 10 business days.

julia: I’ll harden the client handshake and make the reconnect semantics explicit in the SDK docs. Also add a small client-side circuit breaker. Target: code + docs in two sprints.

maria: thanks. I added a short checklist of acceptance criteria so we all have the same definition of "fixed":
- partial responses should not be produced when the server is still receiving tokens for the same request
- reconnect path should resume only when sequence/kv checks pass
- alerts fire for consecutive partials > 3 in 5m per route
- runbook updated with clear hands-off vs hands-on steps

kevin: putting a quick heartbeat prototype here:
```json
{"heartbeat_interval_ms":10000, "client_id":"<id>", "seq": 12345}
```
We’ll emit a metric `chat_connection_heartbeat` + `partial_response_count` tagged by route/model.

ahmed: suggestion: add a short-lived request-id cookie on stream start so reconnects can assert continuity. If missing, escalate to fallback model (lower-latency but lower-cost).

julia: +1 on request-id. Also we should handle ordering: if reconnect seq < last-emitted-token, drop duplicate tokens client-side. I’ll add pseudocode in the SDK PR.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation (eng-sre) notified. If you add new alerts, mark them as P2 so we don’t escalate noisily during tuning.

maria: Ownership summary (please reply with :thumbsup: if you accept):
- Heartbeat/alerts — kevin — spike now, alerts PR by Tue — acceptance: alert + dashboard + test alert sim
- Retry/backoff defaults — ahmed — RFC + tests in 10 business days — acceptance: benchmark report + feature flag
- Client handshake + SDK docs — julia — code + docs in 2 sprints — acceptance: SDK tests + migration notes

maria: Also tracking recurring incident pattern: partials spike correlates with short bursts of high-concurrency clients that open many long-lived streams. Long-term idea: adaptive batching + per-tenant stream quotas. Filing follow-on ticket after owners confirm.

kevin: acked. I’ll add a synthetic test that simulates N parallel streams with intermittent drops and produces the `partial_response_count` heatmap.

ahmed: ack. I’ll start the load sims and share a baseline by EOW.

julia: ack. I’ll draft SDK changes and link the PR here when ready.

maria: great. I’ll create the tracking epic and add owners + milestones. If anyone needs extra time, call it out here. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
